about_the_game:
Your interstellar café awaits! In StarBrew Station, you are the manager of a fledgling coffee shop in the far reaches of space. Can you transform a humble station into a galaxy-spanning caffeine empire?

AUTOMATE, EXPAND, AND OPTIMIZE

Start by manually brewing your first few coffees, then quickly hire a quirky crew of over 31 alien baristas, technicians, and patrons to automate every step of your business. Expand your operation across 5 visually distinct decks, from the industrial Engineering bay to the lush Hydroponics garden and the exclusive VIP lounge. Each new deck unlocks more powerful units and boosts the production of your entire station!

SURVIVE THE RUSH!

Active management pays off! Every 8 minutes, the station is thrown into a chaotic Rush Hour. For 45 seconds, all machines have infinite servings and your earnings are doubled.

Later, face the Galactic Inspector in a unique "boss fight" to prove your station is worthy of prestige. It's a high-stakes event where all your baristas work together against the clock for massive rewards.

PRESTIGE FOR ULTIMATE POWER

True power comes from starting over. After conquering the Galactic Inspection, prestige to reset your run and earn valuable Prestige Tokens. Spend these tokens on a deep upgrade tree to unlock permanent, game-changing bonuses like faster units, cheaper costs, and massive production multipliers. Amass enough tokens to unlock the legendary Golden Barista, an ultimate unit that will skyrocket your income!

FEATURES

Deep Idle Gameplay: A satisfying loop of automation, optimization, and exponential growth.

31 Unique Units: Hire a diverse cast of aliens across 5 themed decks to run your station.

Rewarding Active Play: Capitalize on Rush Hour events and challenge the Galactic Inspector for huge bonuses.

Meaningful Prestige: A robust system with 17+ unique permanent upgrades that fundamentally change your strategy on future runs.

Fair & Complete Experience: Starbrew Station is free-to-play and designed to be completed without spending money. For players who wish to support development, we offer a selection of purely optional cosmetic DLC and a few balanced gameplay units.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent (2.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000+)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse required, keyboard recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 (3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 750 / RX 560 equivalent)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD for faster load times

short_description: Manage a bustling space station café in this sci-fi idle game! Hire quirky alien baristas, automate your coffee empire across 5 unique decks, and survive chaotic Rush Hour events for massive rewards. Prestige to unlock powerful, permanent upgrades.
